notes.title: Elevate Your Gaming Experience: Join the Playtest
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40423861/cc8c5e45e63d1eb6285e24e5bfeb5369edb83ad9.png

Greetings, Adventurers!

We're thrilled to announce the arrival of a major update for Dad's Dice: History of Legends! This update brings a host of new features, mechanics, and an immersive dynamic quest system that promises to elevate your gaming experience. And guess what?? We need YOU!
 
Join us in playtests on GameRound.co
🎮


What's New:

🌟 Explore fresh and exciting in-game features!
⚔️ Experience innovative mechanics enhancing gameplay.
🎨 Enjoy improved visuals for a more immersive adventure.
📜 Dive into a dynamic quest system for endless challenges.


How You Can Participate:

Join the playtest on G.Round to be among the first to experience these exciting changes! Your feedback is invaluable and will help us shape the future of Dad's Dice.


Thank you for being part of this adventure with us! Your support and feedback mean the world. ✨


Don't forget to wishlist Dad's Dice: History of Legends and explore the DEMO. Stay updated with all things related to the game and be among the first to receive notifications about future updates and exciting developments.


Happy gaming! ːluvː

notes.title: News from developers
notes.content:
Hello everybody!

I am glad to announce that the development stage of the action adventure game Dad's and Dice is confidently approaching the final stage. I would like to share with the audience what is happening behind the scenes, because D&D for us is more than just a game - it is an opportunity to create and make, challenge bold ideas and breathe to the fullest in these difficult times.


Lighting was brought into the dark dungeons, and where also there is light, there is life!
 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40423861/08154f0058c3ce4245574823d67de3650388d106.gif


 Over the past few weeks, the game has implemented a unique arsenal of weapons for each of the 4 heroes.
 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40423861/c4554aadb745a6232e577207b50be64bdfe4d20c.gif


Added unique weapon skills, which will allow you to diversify the battles and get even more pleasure from the passage of each individual dungeon.
 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40423861/7e201e56e0e031149cada5a3af67ef2d0e7928a9.gif


 Lots of FX and handpainted images for various skills have been prepared.
Decorations for all locations are ready.
More monsters!
 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40423861/cdbfb5f0e1f8d52a764e519e76c9eb64415d1965.gif


And of course the Bosses! All Bosses have moved to the polishing stage and each of them will need a unique approach.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40423861/31e01c5342770ae7fa118cb545313838a4bdd484.gif

We focus on interesting mechanics and quality of gameplay. At this stage, we are focusing on improving the visuals part of the game and the balance of the gameplay. And for those who like to feel the product before buying, next week, Dad’s and Dice DEMO!

Thanks for attention!

Yours faithfully,
Mixtape Games development team.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1603870/Dads_and_Dice/
